Command: Rest on the seventh day of Unleavened Bread
Summary: The seventh day of Unleavened Bread is a holy convocation of rest, closing the seven days of unleavened bread.
Commandment: Keep the seventh day of Unleavened Bread as a holy convocation and rest on it.
Application: The moral/ceremonial/civil division is a traditional classification, not Scripture's own division; this law is traditionally classed as ceremonial. The closing rest ended the feast week as it began, in worship rather than work. Debated: some see the commanded observance fulfilled as shadow (Colossians 2:16-17); others keep feasts voluntarily as memorial, not as binding command. The site does not settle whether observance continues.
Purpose: To rehearse God's saving acts at appointed seasons (Leviticus 23); Paul calls Christ our Passover (1 Corinthians 5:7).
